masks.description: Specs for the masks that will be created

expression.description:
A placeholder used to store the expressions for the masks. This is used by the UI
in the dataset preparation flow to create UI based masks.

interval.description: The interval on which the rules will be evaluated

window.description:
The window to check the rule against at every data point. This means that if the rule is met at any data point
in the points within the window, the feature will be 1. The window by default the period after and including
the current data point. If shouldLookBack is true, the window will be the period before and including the
current data point. This param is utilized to implement a period of time before or after the mask that should
also be excluded from training data.

shouldLookForward.description:
Only relevant if `window` is set. If true, the window will be the current data point and the period after it.
If false, the window will be the period before and including the current data.

title:
Type that represents a rule mask for dataset preparation settings. This is used for any mask that is applied based
on one or more sensors' values. Through the UI, non-operational and training/inference rule masks all
represent instances of these rule masks.
name: ReliabilityDataPreparationUiCreateRuleMaskSpec
